title.name: Ring Intercom Plus
title.lead: Your Ring Intercom, with the missing switches.
title.sub: Door opener, ding, call active, Ring-to-Open, unlock duration and restart for the Ring Intercom, next to the official Ring integration.

features.title: Door opener
features.text: A lock entity that buzzes the door open and shows "unlocked" for 5 seconds, also when the door is opened from the Ring app.

features.title: Optional PIN
features.text: With a PIN of 4 to 8 digits the lock opens only with the right code, in dashboards, automations and voice assistants alike.

features.title: Ding and call active
features.text: A ding sensor that stays on for 20 seconds and a call sensor that follows the conversation for up to 3 minutes.

features.title: Settings of the app
features.text: Ring-to-Open, unlock duration (1 to 10 s, analog systems) and a restart button, read every 5 minutes and after each change.

features.title: Uses the Ring integration
features.text: No second login and no second push connection: rings and unlocks come from the event entities of the official integration.

features.title: Next ring opens
features.text: Experimental: the next ring within 60 seconds opens the door. Taken from the guest access of the Ring app.

entities.title: Lock
entities.text: Door opener, with an optional PIN as code.

entities.title: Switches
entities.text: Ring-to-Open and Next ring opens (experimental, attribute until).

entities.title: Binary sensors
entities.text: Ding (20 s on after each ring) and Call active.

entities.title: Number
entities.text: Unlock duration, 1 to 10 seconds, only on analog systems.

entities.title: Diagnostics
entities.text: Hardware revision, intercom type and unlock mode.

items.title: Next to Ring
items.text: Borrows the logged-in client of the official Ring integration. No credentials in Ring Intercom Plus.

items.title: Ring cloud
items.text: Commands go through the Ring cloud, in the format the Ring app uses. Not a local connection.

items.title: Unofficial API
items.text: Ring does not document this interface and can change it at any time.
